authority: User promoted the verified 80% context panel to primary and retained 90% as sensitivity on 2026-10-15; provisional identity and 2010 initialization remain unchanged.

chronology.feature_warmup: explicit pre-signal exact sessions/months; not additional supervised training years

universe.engineering_cohort: dated historical SP500/SP400 union, original denominators preserved

paper_normalization.exhaustive_request: Every admitted native ID from each original cohort must be requested; otherwise all15 are withheld.
paper_normalization.population: At each signal, provisionally identity-admitted original members with all five finite exact past-input raw momenta; one common population for all horizons.
paper_normalization.momentum_long: product(1+r[j], j=t-m+1..t-1)-1: m-1 completed monthly returns
paper_normalization.coverage_threshold_policy: No empirical coverage fraction is invented. Mathematical computability does not establish representativeness.
paper_normalization.prediction_population: All15 available only on the common population when the signal passes every gate; all original rows retained outside X.
paper_normalization.shared_mean_and_sd: Preserve time-varying levels. Do not cross-sectionally z-score shared means/SDs to zero.
paper_normalization.test_signal_cross_section: Recompute with current signal's available past inputs only; no future labels or pooled-time fit.
paper_normalization.paper_attribution: Momentum formulas follow paper equations6-8; common population, ddof and gates are declared V2 adaptations.

context_policy.coverage_denominator: Every original historical member of the specific variable/date/universe or index sleeve, including identity-blocked members.
context_policy.status: Available-observation context; a fixed user-approved engineering threshold, not proof of representativeness.
context_policy.daily_benchmarks: Apply 80% and exhaustive admitted-ID requests separately on EVERY historical daily union/sleeve; retain 90% sensitivity and never project month-end membership backward.
context_policy.individual_history: Exact temporal windows and complete stock/benchmark pairs remain unchanged; no padding, skipping, fill or input imputation.

missingness.fit_interface: Existing TrainingSlice plus explicitly aligned boolean fit_mask
missingness.fit_population: Selected rows must independently have all15 finite baseline inputs, finite available y and completed outcomes within the explicit training/label cutoffs.
missingness.prediction_population: Explicit prediction_mask intersected with all15 finite baseline inputs; no y or future outcome availability consumed.
missingness.imputation: Median of finite values in the applicable training partition only
drop_rules: all finite values missing in that training partition
all finite values constant in that training partition
missingness.missing_indicators: One binary column for every retained predictor, with frozen columns even if training had no missing values
missingness.fit_scope: Fit independently within each inner-training partition and each outer-training window; transform validation/test without refitting.
missingness.missing_labels: Exclude from supervised loss only; retain original prediction/outcome/accounting ledger rows.
missingness.manifest: Fingerprint fitted input/output schemas, medians, drop reasons, fit-key hash and cutoffs. Indicators are derived preprocessing schema, not silently added to the715 base dictionary.

coverage_evidence.role: Past-input coverage and initialization comparison, not model scores or proof of valid economic outcomes

remaining_design: label classes/ties and missing-target rank policy
execution, terminal events, costs and portfolio accounting
